verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents its own background automation: managed payout schedules that run recurring payouts for balance accounts, plus configurable risk-monitoring rules. These are fixed, domain-specific automations. Nothing shows a general way for users to define their own autonomous background workflows. Webhooks only push event notifications and are not automations, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: general user-defined automation or workflow builder, agent-driven background tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Managed payouts allow you to automate fund payouts to users on your balance platform using Adyen's most efficient payout logic.
you can create a managed payout schedule for your balance platform and apply it to balance accounts with the same location and currency
Control when and how users get paid, with a customizable or fully automated solution.
use Adyen's custom tools to configure your own monitoring rules and mitigations
